name: realplus
description: Ask RealPlus New York real estate questions; Codex queries the Snowflake semantic view REALPLUS_BUSINESS.

interface.shortDescription: RealPlus real estate data from Snowflake
interface.longDescription: Answers questions about New York listings, asking and closing prices, rents, closed deals, price cuts, agents, brokerages, customer portal activity and searches by running read-only SQL over the Snowflake semantic view REALPLUS.GOLD.REALPLUS_BUSINESS. On first use a browser window opens: sign in with the Snowflake user you were given.
defaultPrompt: How many sales and rentals are on the market?
How many sales closed per month in 2025 and at what median price?
